docs.title: Home
docs.text: This is hosted in GitHub Pages. Happy Reading.

docs.title: How To Deploy
docs.text: Only manual deployment is supported. GitHub Pages for private repositories is not available for free tier.

docs.title: 1. Add Remote [Only Once]
docs.text: git remote add docs https://github.com/Solenergy-Systems-Inc/envision-standard-backend-docs.git

docs.title: 2. Deploy
docs.text: mkdocs gh-deploy -r docs

docs.title: TransactionDTO
docs.text:
Attributes:

Name Type Description reference_num str

transaction id

start_date str

start date of the transaction in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'

charger_name str

charger used for the transaction

location str

location of the transaction

demand float

kWh consumed during charging session

driver str

name of the driver

duration float

duration of the charging session in hours

email str

email of the driver

payment_amount float

payment amount in PHP

payment_method str

payment method used

conn_type str

type of the connector used for the charging session

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text:
• Ongoing transactions will not have payment_amount associated with them.
  • The payment_method should still reflect what the user selected upon starting a charging session
  • The duration parameter will be continuously updated upon request.

docs.title: [POST] Login
docs.text: /api/login

docs.title: LoginRequestDTO
docs.text:
Attributes:

Name Type Description email str

email of the user

password str

password of the user

is_web Optional[bool]

flag to indicate if the request is from the web app

docs.title: LoginResponseDTO
docs.text:
Attributes:

Name Type Description project_id int

assigned project id to the user

email str

email of the user

user_id int

unique id of the user

master_account str

flag if user is a master account

profile_picture Union[str, None]

profile picture of the user

project_name str

name of the project

user_type str

UserTypeEnum

token str

generated token for the session

subscription_expiry_date Union[str, None]

date when the subscription of envision monitoring expires in the format of "YYYY-MM-DD"

features Optional[List[str]]

list of features available to the user

docs.title: Possible Error Codes
docs.text:
• ACCOUNT_NOT_EXIST - The given email does not exist
  • WRONG_CREDENTIALS - The given password does not match the stored password for the given email address
  • ACCOUNT_LOCKED - Access to the account has been locked by the administrator.
